assembly.gaps: every inter-phrase gap is gated to true digital silence (adaptive threshold = noise floor p10 + 12 dB, ~18 ms fades) — kills the constant ~91 Hz hum the IndicF5 route leaves in pauses
assembly.level_match: plain gain only — each sentence take is gain-matched to the median speech RMS of the set (no dynamics processing; stacked processing audibly ate the voice identity in audits)
assembly.loudnorm: ONE single-pass ffmpeg loudnorm to approx -15 LUFS at the very end; never stack loudnorm passes

backends.note: Pluggable generation backends (see backends.py). Default per language: en -> chatterbox, te/hi -> indicf5-space. Env JULIE_TTS_BACKEND overrides the route for any language; valid values: indicf5-space | chatterbox | elevenlabs | http. The five gates, the re-roll loop and the QC report apply unchanged on top of every backend, and each take's backend is recorded in the QC report. Keys come from the environment ONLY — no secret values ever live in this file.

env: JULIE_TTS_URL (required) — your model server's TTS endpoint
http.request: POST JSON {text, lang, voice}; the response body must be audio bytes (mp3 or wav)

env: ELEVENLABS_API_KEY (required) — read from the environment only, never stored here
JULIE_EL_VOICE_ID — or set voice_id in this section

english_chatterbox.engine: Chatterbox TTS (Resemble AI, MIT) zero-shot clone

measured_profile.emphasis: word STRETCH on hinge words, NOT pitch drama

pace_guard.action: outside band -> ONE regeneration, then an atempo nudge clamped to 1.12x; what was applied is recorded in the QC report, never silent
pace_guard.metric: onset rate (onsets/second) vs the reference's rate

phrase_chunking.note: Generate phrase by phrase: a unit ends at sentence punctuation (joined with her measured 0.66 s gap) or at a comma/semicolon/colon (joined with 0.06 s — a breath, not a pause). Silences the engine invents INSIDE a phrase are squashed.

english_chatterbox.status: LOCKED — approved by Ajju 2026-11-14 ('english ok fix')

gates.note: ALL gates must pass on the SAME take. A sentence with no passing take in max_rolls rolls fails the whole run: the engine exits non-zero with the gate table and writes NO final mp3.

hindi_indicf5.engine: IndicF5 via the ai4bharat/IndicF5 Hugging Face Space, cross-lingual from the Telugu reference (no Hindi reference sample on file — marked UNVERIFIED against the channel until one is supplied)

pace_calibration.note: ONE atempo 1.20 per take is part of the locked Hindi recipe and is always logged in the QC report.
pace_calibration.owner_ear: +20% speed (Ajju, 2026-11-14): approved pace = the standard line at 8.01 s
